name: The Lost Brother
about: A stranger at a great lord's table says he is the King's younger brother, drowned twenty years ago. He knows things only the brother could know. Test him, embrace him or hang him, and whether he is true or false, someone will use him.
title: The Lost Brother

new.name: {first} the Drowned
new.memory: I remember the river, and the cold, and a fisherman's wife who called me by another name for twenty years.

goal.text: Be known again as the King's brother

beats.speaker: stranger
beats.text: At {hall}, a man in a fisherman's coat stands up at {sponsor}'s table and names himself: the King's brother, swept off the ferry at Kingsmere twenty years ago. He has the old King's chin, and a scar on his palm from a boyhood dare.

court.text: {sponsor} of {sponsor.house}: "He knows the name of your first pony, Your Grace, and the words carved under the nursery window. I thought you would want to see him yourself."

options.label: Receive him at court and hear him out
options.hint: the court will watch your face
options.result: {stranger} kneels in the King's hall. Every eye in the room goes from his face to the King's, and back.

options.label: Arrest him as an impostor
options.hint: {sponsor.houseName} −20 · the realm wonders what you fear
options.result: The King's guard takes {stranger} from {sponsor}'s table in chains. In the taverns they ask why a true King would fear a fisherman.

options.label: Pay it no mind
options.hint: nothing now · the tale grows on its own
options.result: The King does not answer. {stranger} tells his tale in every hall {sponsor} takes him to.

beats.speaker: elder
beats.text: {elder}, who served the old King's household when both princes were boys, asks {stranger} questions for three days. He answers most. Some he answers too well.

court.text: {elder} of {elder.house}: "He knows what a prince would know, Your Grace. He also knows what a clever servant would have overheard. There is a nurse alive in the hills who bathed you both. She would know."

options.label: Send for the old nurse (100 gold)
options.result: Riders go into the hills for an old woman who has not seen a court in twenty years.

options.label: Embrace him as your brother
options.hint: {sponsor.houseName} +20 · a brother at court, and whoever stands behind him
options.result: The King embraces {stranger} before the court. {sponsor} weeps the loudest.

options.label: Send him away with a purse
options.result: {stranger} takes the purse, and bows, and goes no further than {hall}.

beats.speaker: elder
beats.text: The nurse looks at {stranger} for a long time, then laughs. He is a mummer's son from the river towns who played the drowned prince in a pageant, and kept playing him.

court.text: {elder}: "An impostor, Your Grace, and {sponsor} fed him, dressed him, and walked him through every hall in the realm. Was {sponsor.he} fooled, or was {sponsor.he} the playwright?"

options.label: Hang the mummer, and fine {sponsor}
options.hint: {sponsor.houseName} −20 · the tale ends on a rope

die.how: They hanged me at Kingsmere for playing a prince too well.

options.result: {stranger} hangs at Kingsmere's gate in his fisherman's coat. {sponsor} pays the fine without a word.

options.label: Pardon him: let him play the fool at court
options.result: {stranger} plays the drowned prince every feast-day now, for the King's amusement. The court laughs, and {sponsor} does not.

beats.speaker: elder
beats.text: The nurse falls to her knees and kisses {stranger}'s scarred hand. The drowned prince is alive, and the realm has two sons of the old King.

court.text: {elder}, quietly: "He is your brother, Your Grace. The law says nothing about a prince who comes back from the dead. You must say it instead."

options.label: Give your brother a seat on the council, and an oath
options.result: {stranger} swears fealty to his brother on the old King's sword, and takes a seat at the council table, away from {sponsor}.

options.label: Exile him across the sea with an income
options.result: The King's own brother boards a ship at the river mouth. {sponsor} rides beside the carriage to the dock.

beats.speaker: sponsor
beats.text: {stranger} sits in the King's cells and says nothing at all. Outside, {sponsor}'s men chalk the drowned prince's sign on the doors of Kingsmere.

court.text: {sponsor}: "A man in your cells for the crime of having your brother's face, Your Grace. The realm is asking what else he knows."

options.label: Try him openly before the lords
options.hint: the truth comes out, either way
options.result: The King's justice will be seen: {stranger} goes before the lords in the great hall.

options.label: Let him die quietly in his cell

die.how: They strangled me in the dark under Kingsmere, and never asked my name.

options.result: {stranger} is found dead in his cell. The guards say it was a fever. The realm says it was a brother.

beats.speaker: stranger
beats.text: {stranger} rides with the King to the hunt and sits at his left hand at feasts. {sponsor} visits him often, and they talk with their heads close.

beats.speaker: sponsor
beats.text: At {hall}, {sponsor} raises the drowned prince's banner: the old King's arms with a blue wave across them. Lords who never loved the crown send men to stand under it.

court.text: {elder}: "They call him the true King now, Your Grace, as if there could be a truer one than you. Buy {sponsor} off, or meet them in the field."

options.label: Buy {sponsor}'s loyalty back (400 gold)
options.result: {sponsor} takes the King's gold and the wave banner comes down. {stranger} wakes alone at {hall}.

options.label: Let them come
options.result: The King sends no gold, only a herald with a date and a field.

beats.speaker: stranger
beats.text: The host of the drowned prince marches on Kingsmere under the blue wave, with {sponsor} at its head and {stranger} beside {sponsor.him}, crowned in river reeds.

beats.speaker: stranger
beats.text: Two sons of the old King ride together through Kingsmere at the midsummer fair. {stranger} sends {sponsor} home with thanks, and the realm stops counting crowns.

beats.speaker: elder
beats.text: The drowned prince's tale ends as it began, in the river's silence. In ten years nobody under thirty believes it ever happened.
